verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents its own exit path: one-click migration from Appwrite Cloud to a self-hosted instance (docs-43), which you can run on any Docker host or Kubernetes cluster (docs-14, docs-68). The dedicated PostgreSQL option also connects directly via psql with backups and PITR (docs-46), so data held there sits in a standard open engine. However, nothing documents a dedicated export of all data (database rows, files, users/auth) into open formats such as CSV/JSON/SQL dumps. File download APIs (docs-10) and CLI resource management (docs-12) are only building blocks for that. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export in open formats, user/auth credential export, migration out to non-Appwrite targets, and independent or hands-on corroboration of leaving.
